mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tracking_log (order_id, tracking_no, location, status, description, create_time, sort_order) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{trackingNo}, #{location}, #{status}, #{description}, #{createTime}, #{sortOrder})

mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id as orderId, tracking_no as trackingNo, location, status, description, create_time as createTime, sort_order as sortOrder FROM tracking_log WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY sort_order DESC
